rules.statement: In a test project, don't report a private sealed nested stub, fake or sample type as a violation of the no-nested-types rule when only that one test file uses it; only ask for a top-level file when several test files share the type.
rules.why: The no-nested-types rule is scoped to production code (src/**), and the test convention from the project template puts a stub, fake or sample type used by one file in that file as a private sealed nested type. Test doubles shared by several files are the ones that get their own top-level files.
rules.check: Before reporting a nested type in test code, check the rule's applies-to scope and whether any other test file uses the type. Report it only if the type is shared across files or isn't private sealed.
